== Notes ==
* Only the target foe is hit with the attack; this skill must hit for the knockdown to take effect.
* Target foe and all foes ''adjacent to target foe'' are knocked down.

==Hero Usage==
* Heroes will use this skill whenever it is charged, but will not change targets to apply the knock down to more foes via the area of effect.

== Trivia ==
*This is one of five (nine in {{reforgedmode}}) elite skills seen in [[Ascalon (pre-Searing)|pre-Searing Ascalon]], where it is used by [[Devona]]. The other four are [[Barrage]], [[Bull's Charge]], [[Hundred Blades]], and [[Ward Against Harm]] (with [["Victory Is Mine!"]], [[Greater Conflagration]], [[Plague Signet]], and [[Elemental Attunement]] in Reforged Mode).
* The animation was changed in the [[Feedback:Game updates/20100225#Warrior|February 25, 2010 game update]].
